title: The repaired mux routing is not exercised by any test
evidence: main_test.go:48,79,253 call getBookHandler/updateBookHandler/deleteBookHandler directly with httptest.NewRequest; no test builds the DefaultServeMux registered in main.go:266-317, so the exact defect FEEDBACK.md asked to repair (/books/{id} never routed) would still pass the suite if it regressed
suggestion: Extract route registration into a newMux() *http.ServeMux and drive at least the GET/PUT/DELETE /books/{id} tests through mux.ServeHTTP

title: ?author= filter is a substring LIKE match, not an author match
evidence: main.go:70 — db.Query("... WHERE author LIKE ?", "%"+author+"%"), so ?author=Author matches 'Author A', 'Author 1' and 'Co-Author'; SQLite LIKE is also case-insensitive for ASCII; live probe: GET /books?author=A returns the book authored by 'A' [200], so the filter works, but the LIKE wildcards make it a substring match
suggestion: Use WHERE author = ? for exact filtering, or document the substring semantics in README.md

title: Error responses are text/plain, not JSON
evidence: main.go:104,114,142,201,243 use http.Error(), which overwrites the Content-Type set at main.go:98/126/168/222 with text/plain; only success bodies are JSON; live probe of a scratchpad build confirms: POST /books with empty title/author returns `Title and author are required` [400] as text/plain, and GET /books/999 returns `Book not found` [404]
suggestion: Write a writeJSONError(w, code, msg) helper so 400/404/500 bodies are JSON like the success paths

title: GET /books returns JSON null instead of [] when the collection is empty
evidence: main.go:82 declares `var books []Book` (nil) and main.go:93 encodes it; encoding/json renders a nil slice as null; live probe confirms GET /books on an empty table returns `null` [200]
suggestion: Initialize with `books := []Book{}` so an empty collection serializes as []

title: Tests write to the same ./books.db the server uses, so a stale file can break the author-filter test
evidence: main.go:29 opens "./books.db" and main_test.go:388 TestMain calls initDB() on that same path; TestGetBooksByAuthorFilter (main_test.go:290) asserts exactly 2 rows match 'Author A', which fails if a previous `go run main.go` left rows behind
suggestion: Make the DB path configurable (env var or initDB(path)) and point TestMain at a temp file

title: rows.Err() is not checked after iterating the books result set
evidence: main.go:83-91 loops on rows.Next() and returns at main.go:93 without checking rows.Err(); a mid-iteration driver error would be reported as a successful 200 with a truncated list
suggestion: Check rows.Err() after the loop and return 500 on error

title: Agent session terminated on a connection error, not on task completion
evidence: .hermes_usage.json shows "completed": false, "failed": true after 36 api_calls; _agent_stdout.log reads "API call failed after 3 retries: Connection error."; _meta.json still records "succeeded": true and scores.json has defect_rate=1.0
suggestion: None for the code — the workspace was already spec-complete and passing before the terminal connection error. Recorded so cross-run comparison knows this cell's turn/token counts are truncated
